parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Misskey instance by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-misskey` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `misskeys://` URL from your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev; on the gateway channels it composes the Misskey API URL from your stored secrets and POSTs a native Misskey `{i, text}` payload directly to `api/notes/create`, bypassing Apprise.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`token_secret`, `host_secret`); the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to your Misskey instance (no Apprise); and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment Misskey destinations, direct, at $0.001 per message.

parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Misskey destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Misskey instance (no Apprise)

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Misskey host

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Misskey token
